about: Post-deploy guard for kolaboro.com. After each push GitHub Actions waits for the commit to be live, runs the public smoke checks (/open/deploy-smoke.mjs) and, if they fail twice, restores the files changed since the last passing commit. Code: /open/deploy-guard.py.
canary: Cloudflare Pages sends each push to all visitors at once and offers no percentage canary, so none is claimed. A bad push can be visible for a few minutes until the rollback is live.
rollback_mode: Rollback: a git commit restoring the files changed since the last passing commit; Pages deploys it in about 1 to 2 minutes. An instant Cloudflare API rollback is built in but needs a Pages-scoped token, not configured yet.

checks.name: tls: plain http redirects to https
